verses.ala-ya-ahla-dawfala-s-tafiqu-c1-v1: ʾalā yā ʾahla dawfāla stafīqū waqad ḥāna r-raḥīlu ʾilā l-qabūri
verses.ala-ya-ahla-dawfala-s-tafiqu-c1-v2: waqad ḥāna r-raḥīlu walaylu zādi ʿazīzu waṭ-ṭarīqu ʾakhū l-wuʿūri
verses.ala-ya-ahla-dawfala-s-tafiqu-c1-v3: daʿū ʿinda l-masājidi rafʿa ṣawti walaysa r-rafʿu yurḍī lish-shakūri
